# ESC 365

> A comprehensive cardiology knowledge hub powered by the European Society of Cardiology, offering AI-powered search, clinical guidelines, medical education, and evidence-based resources for cardiovascular professionals.

ESC 365 is the European Society of Cardiology's primary digital platform for continuing medical education and clinical knowledge. It integrates congresses, webinars, courses, and curated publications with specialized knowledge tracks on conditions like hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and lipoprotein-a management.
